featured.title: Local LLM Inference & Performance Evaluation Lab
featured.description: Benchmarked local LLM pipelines, including Qwen 27B-class models, across GPU and memory-constrained CPU paths.

Profiled throughput, concurrency, and latency/privacy/cost routing criteria.

featured.title: Personal AI Automation & Orchestration Platform
featured.description: Modular agentic platform combining LLM tool execution, browser automation, scheduled pipelines, and semantic memory.
highlights: Routes workloads across local Ollama models and hosted OpenRouter APIs.
Supports technical research, scheduled automation, and operational workflows.

featured.title: Self-Hosted Linux Infrastructure & Reliability Homelab
featured.description: Containerized Linux services with Docker, service health monitoring, failure recovery, scheduled patching, and automated backup architecture.
highlights: Operates production-style services with health checks and recovery procedures.
Maintains an automated 3-2-1 backup architecture and scheduled maintenance.
